publicDashboard.label: Public Community Dashboard
publicDashboard.helpText: Allow all subreddit visitors to view the flair analytics dashboard. If disabled, only moderators can view the data.

lookbackDays.label: Lookback Period (Days)
lookbackDays.helpText: Number of days in the past to analyze (e.g. 30, 60, 90, 180). Default: 90

maxPosts.label: Maximum Posts to Ingest
maxPosts.helpText: Maximum posts to fetch (100 to 1000). Note: Reddit API listings enforce a strict 1,000 item ceiling. Default: 1000

minPostsThreshold.label: Minimum Posts for Highlights
minPostsThreshold.helpText: Minimum post count required for a flair to be eligible for Highest/Lowest Response ranking cards. Default: 5

customGroups.label: Custom Flair Groupings (Optional)
customGroups.helpText: Group flairs into categories. Enter one group per line in 'GroupName: flair1, flair2' format. Leave blank for no grouping.
customGroups.placeholder:
Discussion: Question, Peer Help, Open Chat
Promotions: Vendor, Showcase, Deals

items.label: Create Flair Dashboard Post
items.description: Configure and publish an interactive flair dashboard post to your subreddit
